summary: Revalidated Freeport-McMoRan against the SEC-filed Q2 2026 results exhibit and current 2026-07-27 market and FX data. Copper leverage, current margins, cash generation, balance-sheet capacity, and liquidity support medium-confidence baseline eligibility, while Grasberg normalization, Indonesian operating terms, minority interests, commodity cyclicality, and valuation remain material gaps. At the USD 62.72 mark, bounded 12-month earnings scenarios imply 48.0% downside and 24.5% base-case downside. No conviction strategy follow-up was enqueued because both scenario values remain below the mark and the canonical relationship review is already queued separately.
